# Test extension `peers` (spec 057, T069)

The extension of the quickstart and the e2e scene `extension-peers`. It invites a contact, opens
and joins lobbies, sends fast, timed and reliable messages and closes channels through `client.peers`
of the released vault-sdk, and keeps every `peers:*` event it gets. The scene drives it through
`window.peersProbe` inside the frame; the page lists the latest events. Its bundle `../peers.xt` is
built and signed by `tests/extension_e2e_fixtures.rs` with the fixtures' test key.

| File            | Role                                                                          |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `manifest.json` | The manifest; declares `peers` (`connect` on `*`) and reading all contacts    |
| `main.js`       | `window.peersProbe`: the calls, the events kept, the counters and the delays  |
| `index.html`    | Entry page: how many events arrived and the latest ones                       |
| `app.js`        | Generated by `build.sh`: `main.js` bundled with the released SDK, do not edit |

A timed fast message is 1,024 bytes long and starts with the byte `0x54` and the sender's
`Date.now()` as a big-endian float64; the receiver stores the difference as a delay (SC-004). A scene
with two devices on one machine has one clock, so the delays are the real ones.

`app.js` contains, bundled with esbuild 0.28.2 (from holzi's `node_modules`), unchanged:

- `@haex-space/vault-sdk` 4.9.0, the release with `client.peers` (haex-space/vault-sdk PR #88); npm
  tarball integrity
  `sha512-x8FmpJk/71uQD+Na1HAqtKh97SfXC3yirKxoSOrKQpAO4zL8yRN/Yu66Otr0itPinFsihz/yxmFoCQzGMRiAKQ==`
  (source: haex-space/vault-sdk, release commit `de2c013409659939c2288daa03638af53c9a50ba`)
- `drizzle-orm` 0.45.4, a dependency of the SDK

`build.sh` checks the SDK's integrity and builds the same bytes on every run. After a change:

```sh
src-tauri/tests/fixtures/extension_e2e/peers/build.sh
HOLZI_WRITE_E2E_FIXTURES=1 cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test extension_e2e_fixtures
```
